raw_user_phrasing: ## Sources (priority order) 1. RAWG (api.rawg.io) - the spine. 2. CheapShark (cheapshark.com) - keyless. 3. Steam Web / SteamSpy - keyless. 4. HowLongToBeat - no official API. 5. OpenCritic - optional (free key)

auth_scoping.detail: RAWG free API key (RAWG_API_KEY env var); Steam store endpoints keyless. No paid sources; no gating tradeoff.

kept: rawg (spine: search, detail, discover, suggested/similar, game-series, added_by_status, genres/tags/platforms/stores/developers/creators/lists)
steam-web-steamspy (keyless appdetails + appreviews: review-score summary in ratings only)
dropped: cheapshark (deal/price scope excluded by course correction; belongs in a post-publish amend)
howlongtobeat (no official API; playtime covered by RAWG per-game playtime field)
opencritic (no distinct value vs RAWG metacritic field)

priority_check: No inversion: rawg (primary) owns 27/27 absorbed feature surfaces and every transcendence feature spine; steam-web enriches only the ratings column.
